input.quote: (vi) Return of Materials. Within ninety (90) days after the end of the Wind-down Period, upon request by Array, Ono shall either deliver to Array or destroy all tangible items comprising, bearing or containing trademarks of Array (including the Product Trademarks), trade names, patents, copyrights, designs, drawings, formulas or other Data, photographs, samples, literature, sales and promotional aids ("Product Materials") and Confidential Information of Array, that is in Ono's possession, subject to Ono's right to keep one (1) copy for archiving purposes.
input.rationale: Article XIV's exit machinery runs entirely one way: Ono must transition Clinical Studies, assign Regulatory Filings, hand over all Data, Ono Know-How and customer data (p0659, p0660), and return or destroy Array's Confidential Information and Product Materials (p0662). Article X contains no return/destruction provision at all (no "return or destroy" language exists elsewhere in the document), and nothing obliges Array to return, export or delete Ono's Data or Confidential Information, or to certify deletion. The only assistance obligation available to us is the mutual wind-down cooperation covenant in 14.2(a)(iv), which is directed at transitioning the Product back to Array rather than at supporting Ono, and is unconnected to any data return. With no data return or export obligation on the counterparty at all, the clause fails even the fallback (data export within 30 days) and sits in walk-away territory, so we propose inserting a reciprocal Section 14.2(b): up to six months' transition assistance at Array's then-current rates, return of our Data and Confidential Information within thirty days in machine-readable form, and certified deletion thereafter, carved back for the Data and Ono Know-How Array is expressly entitled to retain under 14.2(a)(iii) and (v) so the negotiated licence bargain is preserved.

proposal.summary: Insert reciprocal Section 14.2(b) requiring Array to provide transition assistance and to return, delete and certify deletion of Ono Data and Confidential Information on termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.2 only requires Ono to hand back Data, Product Materials and Array's Confidential Information; nothing obliges Array to return or delete our Data and Confidential Information or to help us transition. We have added a reciprocal exit provision consistent with our playbook (up to six months' assistance at Array's then-current rates, return of our data within thirty days in machine-readable form, then certified deletion); we can live with ninety days of assistance if six is unworkable.

ops.text: (b) Return of Ono Data and Confidential Information; Transition Assistance. Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, (i) at Ono's request, Array shall provide reasonable transition assistance to Ono, its Affiliates and its designees for a period of up to six (6) months following the effective date of such expiration or termination, at Array's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days after Ono's written request, Array shall return to Ono all Data and Confidential Information of Ono then in Array's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format, excluding any Data or Ono Know-How that Array is expressly licensed or otherwise entitled to use or retain under this Agreement (including under Sections 14.2(a)(iii) and 14.2(a)(v)); and (iii) thereafter Array shall delete or destroy all such Data and Confidential Information of Ono from its systems and records, subject to Array's right to keep one (1) copy for archiving purposes, and shall certify such deletion or destruction to Ono in writing.
